MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 38
   C. 30
   D. 19

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 46
   C. 23
   D. 120

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

4. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 15
   D. 30

6. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 19
   C. 88
   D. 38

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

9. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 2/3

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

12. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 12.5

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

14. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

17. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

18. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

20. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 8

21. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

22. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

23. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 43
   C. 31
   D. 49

24. Solve for x: x + 9 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 14
   C. 9
   D. 6

25. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

26. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 57
   D. 15

27. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 18

28. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

29. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

30. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 2
